run_id.description: Owned run ID returned by SubmitCodingTask or ListCodingRuns. Runs submitted by another caller are not visible.

after_seq.description: Read events strictly after this sequence (default 0). Pass next_seq while more is true. Cannot be combined with before_seq.

limit.description: Maximum events in this page, 1–500 (default 500). Follow more and next_seq for additional events.

before_seq.description: Read the preceding event window; zero selects the latest window. Cannot be combined with after_seq.
